text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having missed out on 1st place in the 
Satsuki Sho, Narita Brian recognized her 
own naivety and swore she wouldn't lose 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she missed out on first place, her 
running shocked the other Umamusume of her 
generation. Reporters dubbed her a 
"Monster" and featured her in the news 
headlines.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her focus was set entirely on her 
next objective: the Japanese Derby.
